key.name: look
key.description: silik: the title bar is the command line, a text rail of keys, a status bar. bar: one bar across the bottom, the applications as icons. island: one floating piece centred at the bottom.

key.name: accent
key.description: ink: one ink on paper, the look as it was. steel, cobalt, silicon (silicon indigo), volt (volt violet), spark (spark yellow): what is selected, focused, on or running takes that colour; text, frames and the mark stay ink on paper. NAME-vivid: the title bars too, in a deep tone of it. `silik look --accent` sets this key and the GTK and shell themes SilikOS-NAME with it.

key.name: glass
key.summary: Glass: the floating panes over a blur of what is behind them
key.description: true: the island (or the bar), Start and the COMMAND bar are translucent paper over a blur of what is behind them (which glass: the key glass-mode), with their muted text darker so that it reads at 4.5:1 on any background. false: solid paper. The Silik look's title bar, rail and status bar are solid either way. `silik look --glass off|on|clear|crystal|crystal-thin` sets this key and glass-mode.

key.name: glass-mode
key.summary: Which glass, while the key glass is true
key.description: on: paper at 0.86 over the blurred wallpaper. clear: paper at 0.70 over the blurred wallpaper. crystal: paper at 0.72 over the blurred windows behind the pane and the wallpaper. crystal-thin: paper at 0.55, a stronger blur. Every text colour of a mode reads at 4.5:1 with black behind the paper (tools/gen_accents.py). The key glass stays the switch (a setting made before there were modes keeps its meaning): `silik look --glass off` sets it to false and leaves this key as it is.
